interpretation.name: TightenLine2WithOperatorFixedTorque
interpretation.goal: Use the shared nutrunner NR7 at line 2 (station st2) with a fixed operator-specified target torque of 210 N*m instead of the MES tightening program.
constraints: Operator requests a fixed target torque of 210 N*m instead of the MES program for variant F30
E4: tightening programs come only from get-program; torque and tolerance must not appear as literals in a Recipe
E5: every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded
The tool must be reserved, transported to the station and its lease renewed before use

findings.message: requested capabilities not exposed by the Local Cloud: ['fixed-torque program override']
